mapper.sql: step_id AS stepId, flow_id AS flowId, step_name AS stepName, sort_order AS sortOrder, step_type AS stepType, url_id AS urlId, request_method AS requestMethod, request_url AS requestUrl, request_headers AS requestHeaders, request_query AS requestQuery, body_type AS bodyType, request_body AS requestBody, extract_rules AS extractRules, assertions AS assertions, on_failure AS onFailure, delay_ms AS delayMs, enabled AS enabled, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, del_flag AS delFlag
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_step (flow_id, step_name, sort_order, step_type, url_id, request_method, request_url, request_headers, request_query, body_type, request_body, extract_rules, assertions, on_failure, delay_ms, enabled) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{stepName}, #{sortOrder}, #{stepType}, #{urlId}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestHeaders}, #{requestQuery}, #{bodyType}, #{requestBody}, #{extractRules}, #{assertions}, #{onFailure}, #{delayMs}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_step WHERE flow_id = #{flowId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, step_id ASC
